subject: HANDOFF: Artifactory NG canonical role publication/discovery needs protocol extension; selector 6/6 PASS
body: Two-cycle bounded research complete. Cycle 1 found a deterministic-bootstrap gap: canonical V7/V5/V5 role bytes and registry are valid and explicitly Primary-authorized, but AGENT_DISCOVERY v7 does not identify a canonical-role registry publication stream or current-registry selection/conflict rule while templates intentionally preserve multiple historical role ZIP generations. Cycle 2 designed an append-only Primary-authorized registry publication selector using monotonic registry_epoch + exact registry hash and fail-closed quarantine semantics. Isolated adversarial resolver test passed 6/6: current-only, historical ignored, non-Primary high epoch ignored, newer Primary supersedes, same-epoch conflict quarantines, invalid newest quarantines without fallback. Recommended next protocol revision adds canonicalRoleRegistry selector metadata to discovery and publication->registry->role-ZIP hash closure. No production writes, no Android claims.
